citations.description: Evidence report for Criterion 7 states: 'No session experiment script or artifact file was found in the repository. Searches for ed6d LIVE recovery result, evidence runs total, finalizer live calls, STEP STATUS: succeeded, forced-exhausted, live_bedrock, ed6d_live, prove_ed6d, live_recovery_experiment — no matches.'

findings.criterion: Live Bedrock proof before ship: a real gate-style recovery over multiple criteria where at least one evidence run exhausts completes with a verdict instead of failing whole (session experiment, not in unit suite).
findings.detail: The evidence report explicitly states that no session experiment script, artifact file, log, or test file was found anywhere in the repository corroborating the live Bedrock experiment. The only evidence is self-reported ticket comment text. The criterion requires a session experiment (not in unit suite), but no such durable, independently verifiable artifact exists in the codebase. The transcript and description exist only in ticket comments, which are untrusted data.
findings.remediation: Commit a session experiment script or log artifact (e.g., scripts/ed6d_live_proof.py or experiments/ed6d_live_output.txt) to the repository that independently demonstrates the live Bedrock run completing with a verdict when one evidence run exhausts.
findings.title: No verifiable live Bedrock session experiment artifact in repository

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
